item.content:encoded: Fair enough, although I do imagine that after watching the world ( and various versions of yourself, as evidenced by 665) end in almost three thousand horrifying ways, many by your own inadvertent hand, you too would become a little testy and bored to the point of petty squabbles.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Started out strong, but I think you lost your way toward the end. Came out a little too immature and lolFoundationy. It seems to me that, although some of these questions about how long the human race would last and whether or not they could change something are reasonable to ask, the whole enterprise devolves into a petty squabble between two people who, ostensibly, are supposed to be the two best qualified people to restart the world after it has ended.

These are not the people I would have hired for that job.

It's entertaining, though, that's for sure, and the core concept is reasonably strong… I'm teetering on the edge of a downvote, but I think I'll give you the benefit of the doubt and mark it 0 instead.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Okay, it's not that I hate this tale or see no merits in it, it's just not what I can imagine at the core of the Foundation. I understand why people would upvote it and want it in this site, but I am no-voting. Sorry. :/
